seen.extent: 2 folders (Box 615, Folders 8192-8193), ca. 1878-1882 (dated 1877-1879 in the tree)
seen.cipher: Finding aid scope note: 'Ciphers, or telegraph codes were used to shorten long telegraph messages ... They utilized a number of code words which were used to replace complicated or regularly used phrases. This group contains several ciphers used in telegrams between Perkins and other CB&Q officials.' So the folders hold code-word lists (keys), not ciphered messages.
